decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is central to the firm's coolant-management systems and costs little to keep, and two years on the market is still too little evidence to justify abandoning the option.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the filtration portfolio at low marginal cost, and its value is still unfolding, so the option stays open.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple with steady metalworking demand, and nothing suggests their value will go unrealized.
The magnetic belt conveyor shares the established conveyor platform, so keeping it costs little while it adds breadth to the modular range.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core product type for machine tool users, and dropping them would weaken the modular offering for minimal savings.
